proposals.evidence: DEDR 3098 full article (p. 269) gives 3098 Ta. taru (tār-, imper. tā; past tant- ) to give to 1st or 2nd person (meaning: Tolk. Coll. 1. 29); taruvi (-pp-, -tt-) to cause to bring. Ma. taruka, tarika (tār-, tā; tann-) to give to Bhat tar “to give to I or II person” matches Lindgren Koraga tar “give” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
